reviews.author: Mike Diodati
reviews.text: Vincent and his crew removed and reinstalled drywall in my breakfast nook because wallpaper would not come off and to remove a popcorn ceiling. They were excellent. Vincent showed up everyday, kept me informed, pricing was fair and the job was done expertly with total clean up. Do not hesitate to use this company!

reviews.author: Erin N
reviews.text: We feel very fortunate to have found Vincent and his company, Diamond Restoration Contractors. We could tell from our first meeting with Vincent that he was very honest and that we could trust him. He gave us a competitive price and his workers did a great job. They were very skilled, competent, neat and good at cleanup. We love our new roof and new gutters. We would definitely recommend Vincent and his company to everyone!

reviews.author: Debra Albuquerque
reviews.text: I couldn't be happier with the experience I had with Vince. From start to finish, everything was handled professionally and efficiently. The team was punctual, worked quickly without cutting corners, and left the area spotless when the job was done. The new roof looks amazing, and the price was very reasonable-no surprises, just great service. It is rare to find someone like Vince who delivers on quality, value and cleanliness. Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: Faith Wight
reviews.text: Vincent’s crew did a fabulous job. Professional, reasonable and prompt! I highly recommend his business for all your restoration needs!

reviews.author: Shane Stankiewicz
reviews.text: A couple of years ago> We had our roof done by My Roofing Company. It turned out amazing. We have since bought another property and are looking to get the roof replaced. I will be calling them again for my second property. The picture reflects our first property with the new roof.

reviews.author: Giao Nguyen
reviews.text: Great and reliable company. I had roof replacement with Diamond Restoration company. They did a good job. This is why today I had they to fix the vinyl siding problem. I would recomend this company to my friends for their services.

reviews.author: Gary Catarina
reviews.text: I could not asked a more professional, careful and efficient gentleman and team. We gave recommended Vince and his over a dozen times over the past 6 months.

reviews.author: Michael Dassaro
reviews.text: Vincent and his team did an exceptional job installing a new roof on my house. The work was completed swiftly and with impeccable quality. I highly recommend them for roofing and any other repair needs.

reviews.author: Bryan Volpenhein
reviews.text: Vincent and his crew did amazing work! We got an estimate last year and waited a long time to decide to do the work. When I called him back to see if he could still do the job this year he remembered us and our house. Being a year later and due to Covid issues he sent a new estimate and it was very close to the original. It was a very fair price compared the others we got. Our roof was in bad shape and after they removed the shingles they took their time to repair everything that needed to be done. They replaced rotten wood and repaired all structural damage. Zero shortcuts and Vincent was there to explain it all. We are very happy with the work and confident that our roof will last a long time! I highly recommend Diamond Roofing!

reviews.author: Lorraine Scioli
reviews.text: I never have written a review before but Diamond Contractors did such an amazing job that I have to take a moment. After calling many paver/concrete contractors and getting no answer or return calls I was reluctant to ask the service desk at Home Depot. I put in my info and within the hour got a call from Vincent at Diamond. He was able to stop over that day and got an estimate right out to me for ripping up our concrete patio and replacing with EP Henry pavers. We built our last house from the ground up and have dealt with many contractors. I have to say Vincent was the absolute best! He genuinely cared about the design aspect and wanted to make sure we were happy. There was a little uncertainty if we were going to add a walkway or back patio and he worked with us with no problem. We made last minute decisions and were treated with respect and care. All of the employees doing the install did a great job. Although it was a very big project it was complete with no issues in a little under 2 weeks. I would absolutely recommend Diamond Contractors and I will definitely be using them in the future!

reviews.author: Anthony D
reviews.text: Diamond Restoration was Fantastic, Vincent was very thorough explaining the roofing process answering all our questions. When it came time to install the crew showed up on time, and met all our expectations. Although roofing is a messy project the crew left everything cleaner than they found it! We will refer them to our friends & family!

reviews.author: Dave Valentino
reviews.text: Vincent and his crew are very responsive and professional. I have used their service for many years. 2 paver projects, indoor renovation, and this year, a complete new roof. I am very peticular and I have not been happy with other companies. HIGHLY recommended Diamond!

reviews.author: Samuel Chen
reviews.text: Recently Vincent and his crew helped to replace the entire roof of my house. Vincent is a great guy to work with, professional, responsive, going above and beyond. I am very satisfied with the whole process and the result.

reviews.author: Chris Wilmarth
reviews.text: When we purchased our new home, one of the biggest stressors was knowing that we had to get a new roof based off of the inspection report. I talked to a bunch of contractors and got a wide range of estimates. Vincent made me feel the most comfortable of all of them - thoroughly explaining everything in terms I could understand and just generally seemed like an honest person which is important when you know as little about roofs as I did. I couldn't be happier that I chose to go with Diamond Contractors. We had bad weather in the forecast so his crew worked two 12-hour days to get the job done. They put everything back as they originally found it and Vincent was there in the cold and rain when they all finished to thoroughly check on the job. He gave great status updates along the way and there were no unexpected surprises - his original estimate was spot on. I cannot recommend Diamond Contractors enough if you need a new roof!

reviews.author: Kappy
reviews.text: Great company. They replaced my entire roof. Plywood and everything. Gave us a good price, completed the job in 1 day, and left my property clean. No nails or debris in the lawn or driveway. Vincent answered all my questions thoroughly and always made himself available. He even completed the final review of the work and when something didn’t seem quite right with one of our attic vents he not only replaced the vent the next day, he replaced the oven hood vent as well. He’s a stand-up guy and the company is legit. Will more than likely call them to replace our siding and windows next year.

reviews.author: hiral rupani
reviews.text: Outstanding people and exceptional service! Incredibly professional and reliable. Even after six years, they assisted me with the paperwork I needed for my home insuranceno questions askedand provided it the same day. Truly grateful for their dedication and support. Thank you!

reviews.author: Mike Hayward
reviews.text: We were very happy with the new roof Diamond Contractors put on our home. The roofing crew was both professional and courteous and worked a full day taking off the old roof and putting the new one on. The project manager, Vincent, worked with us every step of the way to make sure we were happy and getting the best quality roofing material for our money. I would highly recommend Diamond Contractors for your home roofing project. Mike Hayward, Brick, New Jersey

reviews.author: Video Shoot Schedule
reviews.text: Diamond Restoration has met all our expectations and more. Our new movers concierge service has met 100's of contractors in New Jersey and selected Diamond Restoration for roofing services in New Jersey, concrete services in New Jersey and patio services in New Jersey. Vincent the owner of Diamond Restoration is very friendly and thoughtful and this shows in the care he has for every job. His entire team is thankful for the job and is committed to exceeding expectations. They keep a clean and orderly job where most contractors in roofing and concrete work don't. We would strongly recommend this contractor. - Video Marketing Research Team At Vouch Video David Porter

reviews.author: Lindsay Gafford
reviews.text: Vincent was quick to respond to me, took his time when looking at our house, and gave his honest suggestions. I never felt like he was trying to upsell me and the final product turned out great! They were pretty fast, too. Would definitely recommend them to family and friends.

reviews.author: Ed Parrilla
reviews.text: Great Team here. Vincent was great to work with. Fast to reply and quick turnaround from agreement to completion. My roof looks amazing!

reviews.author: Angela Dixon
reviews.text: I had a leak in an upstairs room. Called and received a return call the same day. Great price and professional work. Roof was done a year ago. Looks great and no leaks! I would highly recommend this company

reviews.author: Kendall Green
reviews.text: Starting with the owner to the last person laying the nail - professional group and I would recommend them!! Great price and very trustworthy. I got several estimates for my roof and by far the had the best price and even better work!

reviews.author: Cresencio Torres
reviews.text: Thank u I’m very satisfied with absolutely everything you’ve done! From the roof down to cleanliness!!! And always on time phenomenal work !!! Would highly recommend

reviews.author: Charles Amsheyus
reviews.text: Fast estimate, fast turnover done to perfection. No complaints. Start to finish was easy with fair price for work done.

reviews.author: Susan Silva
reviews.text: Vincent is very nice and professional, and he and his great crew do outstanding work! Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.text: I hired Vincent from My Roofing Contractor for a residential roof replacement. The material and container were delivered on time and the crew showed up early on the scheduled start date. The crew worked very hard to complete the job in one day. They are very professional and experts at what they do. The roof looks wonderful and the crew were very careful not to damage my property and cleaned up thoroughly when complete. I would definitely recommend Vincent and his crew to anyone in need of a roof replacement.

reviews.author: Manny A.
reviews.text: Was in need of a new roof and ran into My Roofing Contractor online so I decided to give them a call and I definitely wasn't disappointed. Talked to Vincent and he was very respectful and honest. The guys were very professional and finished it within a day. I'd recommend them to whoever would want a roof replacement.

reviews.author: Mark M
reviews.text: I needed to replace my shingle roof that was in terrible shape. My Roofing Contractor was highly recommended by my neighbor and now I know why.

reviews.author: Gabriela Arevalo
reviews.text: Very professional customer service! I had a very specific service I needed to be done and the company was very patient with me, the work exceeded my expectations! If you’re looking for any work done I definitely recommend them, you won’t be disappointed.
